notes.title: And we're back up!
notes.content:
You should now be able to run PowerBots Retro as a self-hosted game. Just make sure PowerBotsRetroServer.jar is running in the background. (This can be found in the local files by right-clicking the game in Steam and clicking "Manage" > "Browse local files")

Running a separate server instance is a temporary requirement.

notes.title: Working on adding self-hosted server
notes.content:
Note: We may need one more update for this early access game to be back up and running - We're adding a local server to the Java version of PowerBots Retro so that the game can still be played in its full glory while waiting for the Unity rewrite. We're excited to have it back up and running again soon!

Thank you for your patience and continued support.

Added confirm button hint to controller select intro, fixed team attack issue, added Steam Deck controller option, chapter 3 progress, fixed NPC quest glitch when using controllers (used to auto-accept quest before displaying the final chat message)

notes.title: 0.02.01 - Controller support in progress!
notes.content:
Controller and keyboard icons have been added in place of ugly bracket text. Steam Input default config should be added for Xbox and Switch Pro controllers as well. Additional HUD display options have been added, Menu improvements we made that make more sense, options menu and ability to save default settings were added. Also putting in another networking patch attempt to see if the lag issue is resolved, may need further testing.

P.S. I'm sorry brackets, you're beautiful in you're own way. <3

notes.title: 0.01.04 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The cutscene sequence at game startup has been re-added after reprogramming to auto-adjust based on screen size. Also added a fade-in/fade-out effect between slides and added repurposed game artwork to the story panels.

Some NPCs have been re-named and some slight dialogue changes have been made.

The portal inside the doghouse now leads to the outside of the doghouse as it should.

notes.title: 0.01.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have officially released PowerBots Retro! I want to thank you all for all your support and patience as I work to take the game from Early Acces to buttery smooth. This first week has already seen a few major gameplay updates, and I plan to keep looking for ways to improve this game. Bug fixes and additional features are on the way!

Three updates were pushed this week, see details below.

v0.01.01: A quick fix has been uploaded and quests are now up and running again. At launch, completing quests prompted the server to kick the player and it showed as glitchy rooms with no enemies. 

v0.01.02: Temporarily removing the intro story as it was not formatted for all screen resolutions. Working on re-formatting and re-uploading ASAP. (50% complete)

v0.01.03: Fixed a glitch in multiplayer network movement. You shouldn't see players bouncing in random places as much anymore when you leave and re-enter a player-filled room.
